name: Yang You

affiliations.role: Presidential Young Professor of Computer Science; director of HPC-AI Lab

bio: Yang You is a Presidential Young Professor of Computer Science at the National University of Singapore, where Yang directs the HPC-AI Lab, and the founder of HPC-AI Tech. Yang is known for the LARS and LAMB optimizers, which enable large-batch neural network training and appear in the MLPerf benchmark. HPC-AI Tech, founded in 2021, develops the open-source Colossal-AI system for training large models.
known_for: Colossal-AI system for large model training
